## Download and run

1. Download **ReplayAnalyzer.exe** from the assets below.
2. Double-click it. It runs on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), with nothing to install.
3. Keep the League client open, then pick a replay or drag a `.rofl` file onto the window.

Windows may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher because it isn't code-signed. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. This exe was built from this release's public source by GitHub Actions.

For richer data on ranked and normal games (wards, items, levels), paste your own free key from [developer.riotgames.com](https://developer.riotgames.com) into the app. Your keys and saved games stay on your PC.
